proposal.name: Hold selected Python calls across explored steps

plan.name: Hold selected Python calls across explored steps
plan.summary: Add life.hold(entry, *args, expected_before=None, expected_after=None, **kwargs) and life.release(*, expected_before=None, expected_after=None) to explored module lifecycles so Submit can expose an entry's reservation before its worker runs and Finish can complete that same selected call. The harness pauses at the owned worker's first selected-call event, drains all other entry work, permits intervening steps and declared refusals, counts the call once across hold and release, reproduces both during replay, and drains any remaining held work without recording it before another run starts. Keep ownership, authentication, poisoning and the independent deadline watchdog intact, reject unsupported forms and sampled holds, fail invalid or unfinished holds and releases, and treat an empty release as an unchanged D-0200 refusal. Extend authenticated observations and Go validation with hold/release operations and cross-step accounting, and update SPEC.md and README.md with the API, evidence and lifecycle rules, citing D-0186, D-0199 and D-0200 on changed SPEC bullets. This is one tested plumbing change under D-0105; the merger records the new decision refining D-0186 and D-0200, including the declared-refusal interaction from #392, and runs unavailable real Docker checks as merger work.

tests.name: TestPythonApplicationExecutionHeldCalls
tests.says: Actual Python exploration reads a queued reservation before the selected worker executes, refuses a second Submit by its declared exception, releases exactly that call, preserves model step names and replays, and drains owned work between steps and runs without cleanup observations.

tests.name: TestPythonApplicationExecutionHeldCallFailures
tests.says: Invalid holds, second selected calls, unsupported forms, sampled holds, caught collector failures and unfinished release or cleanup work fail promptly with diagnostics and no accepted observations.

tests.name: TestPythonApplicationHeldCallAuthenticatedOperations
tests.says: Go independently rejects authenticated but contradictory hold/release evidence, tracks the held call within each run and across replay, and binds operation metadata into portable evidence.

tests.name: TestPythonApplicationGateHeldCalls
tests.says: The gate checks the queued state, declared busy refusal and Finish against a model with at most one active task, retains exhaustive attempt/state evidence without claiming proof, and runs real Python/TLC checks in opt-in Docker subtests.
